summary: Windows + PowerShell readiness tracker for backend API, SQLite persistence, local production packaging, CI, and release gaps.
active_objective: Keep the in-process backend API, local SQLite database layer, and production verification commands coherent, secure, and testable for Windows desktop deployment.
assumptions: Primary local environment is Windows with PowerShell 7.
Backend API is the loopback-only in-process HTTP server under src\OnlyRag.Api.
Local persistent database is SQLite managed by src\OnlyRag.Infrastructure\Storage.
Local start target is the WPF desktop app: dotnet run --project .\src\OnlyRag.App\OnlyRag.App.csproj --configuration Debug.
Canonical CI/local readiness command is pwsh .\scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 -Configuration Release.
Packaging artifact is the Inno Setup installer under artifacts\installer.
Required environment variables are currently none; optional variables are ONLYRAG_WEB_DEV_SERVER and ONLYRAG_LIBREOFFICE_PATH.
decisions: Use System.Text.Json for chunk metadata JSON persistence instead of manual string interpolation.
Keep API binding restricted to loopback and session-token protection for /api/* endpoints.
Keep schema migrations explicit and reject unversioned preexisting schemas.
Do not change database schema, migrations, endpoint routes, auth model, or deployment target in this pass.
Do not run GUI start as an automated verification step in this session because it launches the interactive desktop app.
Do not run installer packaging until Inno Setup 6 is installed locally.
current_tasks: Install Inno Setup 6 locally or provide -InnoSetupCompiler, then run pwsh .\scripts\Build-Installer.ps1 -Configuration Release.
Install Windows SDK signing tools and configure a trusted code-signing certificate before signed release verification.
Run pwsh .\scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 -Configuration Release -IncludeInstaller on a packaging-capable Windows machine.
Run pwsh .\scripts\Test-InstallerRelease.ps1 -InstallerPath .\artifacts\installer\OnlyRag-Setup-0.1.0-win-x64.exe -RequireSigned -RunInstallLifecycle on a clean Windows verification profile.
Manually launch the app with dotnet run --project .\src\OnlyRag.App\OnlyRag.App.csproj --configuration Debug and verify API loopback binding, WebView2, local storage, and Qdrant startup behavior.
Keep backend/API/database tests in the normal gate when endpoint contracts, migrations, repositories, or job handlers change.
next_tasks: Run the full canonical gate after the current backend/storage patch and existing documentation/frontend changes are ready for integration.
Record installer artifact evidence after Build-Installer succeeds.
Record signed installer lifecycle evidence after clean-profile verification.
Confirm the documented start path manually after the next GUI verification pass.
Add or extend API contract tests if endpoint payloads or auth requirements change.
blockers: Local installer packaging was not run because ISCC.exe was not found in the previous packaging check.
Signed release verification was not run because signtool.exe and a signing certificate are not configured in this workspace.
Interactive local start was not run in this automated pass.
Production release readiness is blocked until signed installer lifecycle verification passes on a clean Windows profile.
risks: Installer packaging can still fail on a packaging-capable machine if Inno Setup, signing tools, or certificate trust are misconfigured.
Local app startup still needs manual GUI verification even though backend/API/storage tests pass.
Parallel dotnet test runs can contend for shared obj outputs; run backend project tests serially when verifying locally.
Generated build outputs and dependencies exist after tests/builds; they are ignored by Git and can be removed with pwsh .\scripts\Clean.ps1 when no longer needed.
structure_notes: Backend API source is under src\OnlyRag.Api.
SQLite storage, migrations, repositories, and ingestion persistence are under src\OnlyRag.Infrastructure\Storage.
Backend and storage tests are under tests\OnlyRag.Api.Tests and tests\OnlyRag.Infrastructure.Tests.
Build outputs are generated under project bin/obj folders.
Frontend production output is generated under src\OnlyRag.Web\dist.
Installer and release evidence outputs are expected under artifacts.

runtime: External Ollama endpoint configured by the user
development: Windows SDK signtool.exe for signed releases
external_services: Ollama local or trusted LAN endpoint
GitHub Actions Windows runner for CI

155 API tests passed when rerun serially after an initial parallel build file-lock contention.
